candidate.title: System 1 vs. System 2 Thinking: The AI Shift #shorts
candidate.description: System 1: quick, heuristic thinking. System 2: slower, deliberate analysis. Are we offloading too much cognitive work to AI, and staying in a shallow System 1 zone? What are the long-term effects? #CognitiveBias #ThinkingFast #AISafety #DecisionMaking
